command_templates.name: Open Registry Hive
command_templates.when: When a shim database file needs to be examined.

usage_description: SDB Explorer is used to analyze shim database files, which can provide insights into application compatibility issues on Windows systems.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Unexpected or large number of entries in the shim database.
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential tampering or unusual application behavior.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Missing critical entries that should be present in a normal shim database.
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate issues with application compatibility or installation.

known_false_positives: Normal variations in shim databases due to different software environments may appear suspicious but are not necessarily indicative of malicious activity.
